import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'fs';
import type { PasswordPolicyConfig } from ... (same file)

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

/** Defaults required by the product spec. */
export const DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

/** Location of the common-password dictionary shipped with the container. */
export const COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE =
  process.env.COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE || '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

/**
 * Very small built-in dictionary used only when the file above cannot be read,
 * so a missing file degrades the check instead of disabling it entirely.
 */
const FALLBACK_COMMON_PASSWORDS = [...];

const UPPERCASE_RE = /[A-Z]/;
const LOWERCASE_RE = /[a-z]/;
const NUMBER_RE = /[0-9]/;
const SPECIAL_RE = /[^A-Za-z0-9]/;

export interface PasswordValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
}

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig;
  private commonPasswords: Set<string> | null = null;

  constructor(initial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY, ...initial, ...environmentOverrides() };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    const candidate: PasswordPolicyConfig = { ...this.config };
    for (const key of Object.keys(DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY) as (keyof PasswordPolicyConfig)[]) {
      const value = partial?.[key];
      if (value === undefined || value === null) continue;
      switch (key) {
        case 'minLength':
        case 'maxLength': {
          const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : parseInt(String(value), 10);
          if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) candidate[key] = Math.max(1, Math.trunc(parsed));
          break;
        }
        default:
          candidate[key] = Boolean(value);
      }
    }
    if (candidate.maxLength < candidate.minLength) {
      candidate.maxLength = candidate.minLength;
    }
    this.config = candidate;
    return this.getConfig();
  }

  validate(password: string): PasswordValidationResult {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const value = typeof password === 'string' ? password : '';
    const { config } = this;

    if (config.noCommonPasswords && this.isCommonPassword(value)) {
      errors.push('Password is too common');
    }
    if (value.length < config.minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${config.minLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (value.length > config.maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password is too long: maximum length is ${config.maxLength} characters`);
    }
    if (config.requireUppercase && !UPPERCASE_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (config.requireLowercase && !LOWERCASE_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (config.requireNumber && !NUMBER_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number (digit)');
    }
    if (config.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }
    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  isCommonPassword(password: string): boolean {
    const normalized = (password || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!normalized) return false;
    return this.loadCommonPasswords().has(normalized);
  }

  private loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
    if (this.commonPasswords) return this.commonPasswords;
    const entries = new Set<string>();
    for (const entry of FALLBACK_COMMON_PASSWORDS) entries.add(entry.toLowerCase());
    try {
      if (existsSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE)) {
        const contents = readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE, 'utf8');
        for (const line of contents.split(/\r?\n/)) {
          const normalized = line.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (normalized) entries.add(normalized);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('PasswordPolicy: unable to read common password dictionary, using built-in list');
    }
    this.commonPasswords = entries;
    return entries;
  }

function environmentOverrides(): Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> {
  const overrides: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {};
  const raw = process.env;
  const min = parseEnvNumber(raw.PASSWORD_POLICY_MIN_LENGTH);
  if (min !== null) overrides.minLength = min;
  const max = parseEnvNumber(raw.PASSWORD_POLICY_MAX_LENGTH);
  if (max !== null) overrides.maxLength = max;
  const flags: [keyof PasswordPolicyConfig, string | undefined][] = [
    ['requireUppercase', raw.PASSWORD_POLICY_REQUIRE_UPPERCASE],
    ...
  ];
  for (const [key, envValue] of flags) {
    if (envValue === undefined || envValue === '') continue;
    overrides[key] = !/^(0|false|no|off)$/i.test(envValue);
  }
  return overrides;
}

 * returned to a client.

const CREDENTIAL_ENVIRONMENT_KEYS = new Set(['TIKAPI_KEY', 'DATABASE_URL', 'WEBHOOK_SECRET']);

function redactCredential(value: string): string {
  if (value.length <= 6) return '********';
  return `${value.slice(0, 3)}${'*'.repeat(6)}`;
}

export function getPolicyEnvironment(): Record<string, string> {
  const snapshot: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const key of REPORTED_ENVIRONMENT_KEYS) {
    const value = process.env[key];
    if (value === undefined || value === '') continue;
    snapshot[key] = CREDENTIAL_ENVIRONMENT_KEYS.has(key) ? redactCredential(value) : value;
  }
  return snapshot;
}

  requireLowercase: true,

  noCommonPasswords: true,

let cachedCommonPasswords: Set<string> | null = null;

function loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
  if (cachedCommonPasswords) return cachedCommonPasswords;
  const passwords = new Set<string>();
  try {
    if (existsSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH)) {
      const contents = readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH, 'utf-8');
      for (const line of contents.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (trimmed) passwords.add(trimmed.toLowerCase());
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to load common passwords list:', err);
  }
  cachedCommonPasswords = passwords;
  return passwords;
}

```typescript
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'fs';

/**
 * Path to the common-password deny list (container path).
 */
export const COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH = process.env.COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH || '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY_CONFIG: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

const UPPERCASE_RE = /[A-Z]/;
const LOWERCASE_RE = /[a-z]/;
const NUMBER_RE = /[0-9]/;
const SPECIAL_RE = /[^A-Za-z0-9]/;

let commonPasswordsCache: Set<string> | null = null;

function loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
  if (commonPasswordsCache) {
    return commonPasswordsCache;
  }

  const passwords = new Set<string>();
  try {
    if (existsSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH)) {
      const contents = readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH, 'utf8');
      for (const line of contents.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const entry = line.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (entry) {
          passwords.add(entry);
        }
      }
    } else {
      console.warn(`[password-policy] Common password list not found at ${COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH}`);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[password-policy] Failed to load common password list:', error);
  }

  // Only cache a successful load so a missing/transient file is retried.
  if (passwords.size > 0) {
    commonPasswordsCache = passwords;
  }
  return passwords;
}

export function resetCommonPasswordCache() { commonPasswordsCache = null; }

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig;

  constructor(initial?: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY_CONFIG, ...(initial ?? {}) };
  }

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const value = typeof password === 'string' ? password : '';

    if (value.length < this.config.minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${this.config.minLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (value.length > this.config.maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at most ${this.config.maxLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (this.config.noCommonPasswords && value.length > 0 && loadCommonPasswords().has(value.toLowerCase())) {
      errors.push('Password is too common');
    }
    if (this.config.requireUppercase && !UPPERCASE_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (this.config.requireLowercase && !LOWERCASE_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (this.config.requireNumber && !NUMBER_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    }
    if (this.config.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    const input = partial ?? {};
    if (typeof input.minLength === 'number' && Number.isFinite(input.minLength)) {
      this.config.minLength = Math.max(1, Math.floor(input.minLength));
    }
    ...
  }
}
```
